brief: Delta since the last run: the board flushed hard, with BTC 24h -3.27 and many alts at -10 to -19, long liquidation almost everywhere and funding resetting to the neutral 10.95. HYPE funding is back at 120.06 after resetting earlier. Two imbalances stand out: XMR HL-local crowded longs (funding 193.62, 140.26 over CEX), proposed as a counter-trend short; and BNB shorts pressing (funding -132.27, OI +114.81), proposed as a long that waits for a reclaim close. Either could fail: XMR on a breakout of the 4h range, BNB on a break under the 1d low. hl-cycles is stale (16.6 h).
